reader.requirement: At --std 85, the INSPECT TALLYING counter identifier-2 must reference an elementary numeric data item: an alphanumeric, alphabetic, numeric-edited, group, reference-modified (class alphanumeric by §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5) or index data item is refused, and any elementary numeric item (signed, scaled, binary, subscripted) is accepted and incremented.

edition-consulted.switches: only the citation text in the COBOL0847 message (§1985:VI.6.18.3 SR6 and §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 at 85, §2023 numbers otherwise); the accept/refuse decision is the same predicate at every edition

reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover an index item counter and reference-modified/whole counters; alphanumeric, alphabetic, numeric-edited and group counters and the positive signed/binary/scaled/subscripted counters are exercised only by the probes here

probes.printed: COBOL0847 'shall be an elementary numeric data item (§1985:VI.6.18.3 SR6)' for X PIC X(3), group G, E PIC ZZ9, A PIC A(3), N (2:2) (with the GR5 note), IX USAGE INDEX

probes.expected: C2 S9(4) COMP -2 + 5 = 3; C3 9V9 0.5 + 10 CHARACTERS = 10.5 truncated to 0.5 in 9V9; C5 (I) subscripted counter = 5
five counters in one TALLYING phrase; left-to-right first-match: C1 takes every A (5), C2 none (-2), C3 CHARACTERS BEFORE C counts B (0.5+1=1.5), C4 LEADING none (1), C5(2) none (0)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR6  (6.18.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6
OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5  (4.3.8.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: The screen asks the class of the PLACE (Table16Operand), so a reference-modified numeric counter is refused as GR5 requires. Side observation for another rule: DISPLAY of a PIC 9V9 item printed '1.5'/'0.5' (an inserted decimal point) where a display-usage item would be shown as its digits; not this rule's concern.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-236/runs: r3_neg2 refuses (COBOL0847 citing §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR6) a level-66 RENAMES R1 THRU R2 counter (a group), a PIC X(2) counter in Format 3 (TALLYING ... REPLACING), and a group counter in Format 3; r3_neg refuses FUNCTION LENGTH (X) as identifier-2 (COBOL5506 parse refusal; a function is never a receiving operand). r3_pos runs: 66 RN RENAMES R1 (elementary numeric) counts 3 (RN=03); PACKED-DECIMAL counter in Format 3 C2=+003 with X=AACCA; BINARY counter 10+5 CHARACTERS=0015; PIC 9PP counter 0+3 -> 000 (scaled truncation); class f: INSPECT X TALLYING I FOR ALL "A" TC (I) FOR ALL "C" with I=1 gives I=4 T=200 (subscript evaluated once first, §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR5). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR6  (6.18.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6'; 'OK  §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR5  (6.18.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5'.
